title: New Harbor: 'Highly Likely' Bear Market in 2026

excerpts.label: Highly likely 20%+ drawdown in 2026
excerpts.insight: Despite near-term bullish indicators, expect significant turmoil and true bear market next year
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Don't chase year-end strength—position for volatility and potential 20%+ correction

excerpts.label: 500-point blowoff signal
excerpts.insight: Watch for 500 S&P points up in 2-3 weeks as blowoff top signal—not a buy signal, a sell signal
excerpts.pm_takeaway: If vertical ramp occurs, reduce equity exposure aggressively; add hedges

excerpts.label: 60/40 became 80/20
excerpts.insight: Passive 60/40 from 2019 now looks like 80/20—at record valuations
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Rebalance now; use year-end as opportunity to right-size equity exposure

excerpts.label: Silver broke $50 and kept going
excerpts.insight: Unlike 2011 collapse from $50, silver consolidated and broke higher to $72—different structure
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Silver saying something different; long-term bullish but trim if >20-25% of portfolio

excerpts.label: Gold/silver ratio normalizing
excerpts.insight: Ratio fell from 102 at liberation day to 62—approaching 50 long-term average
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Normalization supports trimming silver; sell into strength, don't wait for perfect top

excerpts.label: Sector rotation: materials over tech
excerpts.insight: Hyperscalers losing relative strength; basic materials (metals/mining), healthcare improving
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Rotate from financials/tech to global metals & mining; favor equal-weight over cap-weight

excerpts.label: Math of loss: 50% down needs 100% up
excerpts.insight: Simple asymmetry of losses—shallow drawdowns much easier to recover from
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Capital preservation in late cycle matters more than chasing upside
